html:
SMTO-UI-0058 — Choose a new password

GUID: 7a4ff15a-ead8-55cf-bfa3-66f2166fb217
Slug: password-change-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: authentication

What happened

  • Your account is still using a temporary password from an administrator. You need to choose your own password before SMTO opens your workspace.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On the Account page (SMTO opens it for you), type the temporary password you were given into Current password. SMTO needs the temporary password to confirm that it's really you making the change.
  2. Type a new password of at least 8 characters, different from the temporary one, into New password and again into Confirm new password. Then select Change password. Your own password replaces the temporary one, which was only meant for your first sign-in.
  3. Go back to your workspace. Once the change is saved, SMTO stops sending you to the Account page.

What success looks like

  • SMTO confirms the password change and your workspace opens normally.

If it still fails

  • If you don't have the temporary password, ask your administrator to use Reset password on the Users page and give you a new one privately. Never put passwords or browser cookies in error reports.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The portal middleware returned password_change_required because the signed-in account has must_change_password set (new account or administrator password reset), so only the Account page and password-change requests are allowed.

What this means

  • This account must replace its temporary password before opening the workspace. This reports access to the current request, not the outcome of previous operations.

Why this can happen

  • This account must replace its temporary password before opening the workspace.

How to diagnose it

  • Account settings save and the workspace opens.

How to fix it

  • Submit the Account page (/account) password form, which POSTs /auth/password with the temporary password and a new 8 to 128 character password; success clears must_change_password and signs out the account's other sessions. If the temporary password is lost, an administrator can issue a new one with Reset password on the Users page (/user).
  • Open Account and choose a new password, then return to your workspace.

Retry and execution caution

  • Account settings save and the workspace opens.

How to verify the fix

  • Account settings save and the workspace opens.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Authentication guidance never changes account permissions or replays task work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
